description: Set a trip's cover photo from an image URL or a place_photo_reference returned by places_search/place_details. Becomes the trip's hero image immediately. Provide the trip_id from trips_list.

image_url.description: Direct https:// image URL to use as the cover. Provide this or place_photo_reference.

place_photo_reference.description: A photoReference from a places_search/place_details photos entry. Provide this or image_url.
